rounds.ai_message: Chen, this is Daniel. Our forwarder just told us the NYC-bound vessel is fully booked for next week. What's our plan B?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 陈,我 Daniel。我们货代说下周去纽约的船没舱位了,有 B 方案吗?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 回应问题,提供替代方案或交涉空间
key_phrases: Let me check with our forwarder
Sailing on the 22nd to Long Beach instead
rounds.common_mistakes: 不要只说 'We'll figure it out'。客户问 plan B,需要具体方案:转港、走其他船公司、加钱订舱。
rounds.tips_zh: 缺舱时常规操作:转相近船期 / 转附近港口再陆运 / 接受加价。给客户选项,不要单选。
rounds.user_response_example: Let me check with our forwarder now. I see two options: MSC has a sailing on the 22nd to Long Beach with transshipment to NYC, or Maersk has a direct slot to Newark on the 25th. Which one works better for you?

rounds.ai_message: Long Beach is fine if it's faster. But I need an updated ETD and ETA in writing by end of day.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 长滩可以,只要更快。但今天下班前我要书面的 ETD 和 ETA。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认能提供并设定期限
rounds.common_mistakes: tentative(暂定)vs confirmed(确认):给客户前要明确标注,免得后面翻脸。
rounds.tips_zh: 正式报价 / 船期 / 装柜日,落文字,口头不算。
rounds.user_response_example: Will do. Tentative ETD Ningbo is the 22nd, ETA Long Beach around the 11th of next month. I will email you the official update by 5 PM today.

rounds.ai_message: Good. Now the stuffing — our QC wants to do a pre-shipment inspection on Friday morning. Will the cargo be ready?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 行。装柜这边,我们的 QC 周五上午要做一次装柜前检验,货能好吗?
key_phrases: We can arrange the inspection on ...
Please confirm the inspector's arrival time
rounds.common_mistakes: PSI(Pre-Shipment Inspection)不是客人随便来的 — 要走正式流程,定好时间和人员。
rounds.tips_zh: 装柜前检验要提前 24-48 小时确认货物已入库、外箱唛头清晰可读。
rounds.user_response_example: Yes, production finishes Thursday afternoon, and the cartons will be in our warehouse by Thursday evening. We can arrange the PSI on Friday morning at 9 AM. Please confirm the inspector's arrival time.

rounds.ai_message: The inspector will arrive at 9:30. Make sure your QC manager is on site. By the way, can we do telex release this time? Last time the original B/L took forever to reach us.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 检验员 9:30 到。确保你们 QC 主管在场。另外这票能走电放吗?上次正本提单寄得太慢了。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认电放可行并说明电放条件
key_phrases: Yes, we can do telex release
Once the B/L is issued, the ... will be released
rounds.common_mistakes: 电放(目的港船公司直接放货给收货人)前提:客户已付款或信用证相符,别一上来就答应。
rounds.tips_zh: 电放风险:提单失去物权凭证作用。TT 款到齐或 LC 兑付后才建议电放。
rounds.user_response_example: Yes, we can arrange telex release. Once we receive your full payment, the shipping line will release the B/L to your forwarder at destination. The telex release fee is USD 25.

rounds.ai_message: OK. Last question — for the C/O, our customs broker says we need a 'single country of origin' declaration. Is everything made in China?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好。最后一个问题:产地证,我客户报关行说需要 '单一原产地' 声明。所有货物都是中国产的对吧?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认原产国并说明单据合规性
key_phrases: The C/O will state 'Made in China'
rounds.common_mistakes: 如果用了第三国原料(比如越南的拉链、印度的纽扣),产地证得如实申报,不能含糊。
rounds.tips_zh: 美国海关严查原产地欺诈,Form A 错填可能整批被退或罚款,别图省事。
rounds.user_response_example: Yes, the garments are 100 percent assembled in our factory in Zhejiang, and all trims are sourced domestically. The C/O will state 'Made in China' accordingly.
